name: cublas_cublasZdotc_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasZdotc_v2.py. Conjugated complex128 dot product result = conj(x)^T . y = x^H . y over strided vectors (the real baseline falls back to cublasZgemm_v2 internally). _random_tensor does not support complex, so x/y/result are built by gen_inputs as complex128 from float64 randn; storage sizes are n*incx / n*incy (incy=incx in the test). The test's alpha param is unused by the baseline so it is not an input. reference writes the 1-element result in place and returns it. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
